halloween.lobby.all_ready: Everyone's ready! The match starts in 10 seconds
halloween.lobby.parkour_fell: You fell before the first checkpoint: start again from the green block
halloween.lobby.parkour_ready: Parkour: go! Three checkpoints, then the gold platform
halloween.lobby.ready_alone: You're alone (%s/%s): start a match with /hw start
halloween.lobby.ready_cancel: Someone changed their mind: countdown off
halloween.lobby.ready_count: Ready: %s of %s (the Ready button in the middle of the gym)
halloween.lobby.st.doors.1: Crouch (Shift) and hold right click on a closed door to lock it.
halloween.lobby.st.doors.2: Michael needs several blows to break a locked door: that's time.
halloween.lobby.st.doors.3: Right click a window to climb through, slow and quiet.
halloween.lobby.st.doors.4: Ctrl + right click: fast, but the glass breaks and cuts.
halloween.lobby.st.goal.1: Get out of town alive: through a storm cellar, by car, with the police or through the gate.
halloween.lobby.st.goal.2: Each way out needs its things: bolt cutters, keys, petrol, a repair kit, a fuse.
halloween.lobby.st.goal.3: They are hidden in furniture: cabinets, nightstands, crates.
halloween.lobby.st.goal.4: Save townsfolk: lead them to an exit (+200) or hide them at home (+100).
halloween.lobby.st.grab.1: Left click when the arrow is in the zone: that's how you break free.
halloween.lobby.st.grab.2: Michael hits his own gauge too: whoever's quicker wins.
halloween.lobby.st.grab.3: A knife, ice pick or dart in your pockets: one stab and you're free.
halloween.lobby.st.grab.4: The more he stalked you, the narrower your zone.
halloween.lobby.st.lockers.1: Right click a locker to get in, Shift to get out. A minute of air.
halloween.lobby.st.lockers.2: Inside he can't sense you, but he may throw the door open.
halloween.lobby.st.lockers.3: Run in and it slams loud enough for the whole street.
halloween.lobby.st.lockers.4: Crouching is silent; running on gravel, leaves and glass carries far.
halloween.lobby.st.perks.1: Match points go into your purse, survivors' and Michael's alike.
halloween.lobby.st.perks.2: Key P: the perk shop. A bought perk is yours for good.
halloween.lobby.st.perks.3: Take up to three of yours into a match.
halloween.lobby.st.perks.4: The build can only change between matches.
halloween.lobby.st.practice.1: The button on this stand starts a practice match on your own.
halloween.lobby.st.practice.2: First as a survivor, then as Michael.
halloween.lobby.st.practice.3: Hints at the bottom, sparks over what to use.
halloween.lobby.st.search.1: Hold right click on a cabinet, nightstand or crate to search it.
halloween.lobby.st.search.2: Four places: your hand and three pockets. Wheel or 1-4 picks one.
halloween.lobby.st.search.3: Right click with it in hand to use it (throw, heal, shine).
halloween.lobby.st.search.4: The flashlight runs down and flickers at the end: find batteries.
halloween.lobby.st.shape.1: Sense (R) shows victims; watching them stalks them, which weakens them.
halloween.lobby.st.shape.2: Bloodthirst grows with stalking and kills: harder blows, shorter cooldowns.
halloween.lobby.st.shape.3: Shape Jump (V): unseen and fast, but you can't leave it in the light.
halloween.lobby.st.shape.4: Ctrl dashes, right click grabs, left click strikes. He hears running.
halloween.lobby.st.stamina.1: Running: 6 m/s for about 8 seconds. Out of breath, you can only walk.
halloween.lobby.st.stamina.2: Standing still or hiding, your breath comes back twice as fast.
halloween.lobby.st.stamina.3: Watching Michael or finding a body builds panic: heartbeat, shaking.
halloween.lobby.st.stamina.4: Panic fades far from him and from bodies.
halloween.lobby.tip.10: Tip: each storm cellar lets out only one.
halloween.lobby.tip.11: Tip: the car waits until two are in or the driver presses Space.
halloween.lobby.tip.12: Tip: perks are on key P.
halloween.lobby.tip.2: Tip: a locked door holds Michael up for several blows.
halloween.lobby.tip.3: Tip: a flashlight in his face blinds Michael.
halloween.lobby.tip.4: Tip: a townsperson led to an exit is worth +200.
halloween.lobby.tip.5: Tip: in fog they notice you closer, and you see less too.
halloween.lobby.tip.6: Tip: Shape Jump can't be left in the light: keep by the lamps.
halloween.lobby.tip.7: Tip: the police can only be called once a body is found.
halloween.lobby.tip.8: Tip: panting carries: catch your breath under cover.
halloween.lobby.tip.9: Tip: the flare gun and the rifle knock Michael down in one hit.
halloween.cutscene.survivor: Find a way out. Don't let him see you.

halloween.perk.slippery.desc: In Michael's grab, your zone is wider
